written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Robin has a numerical goodwill score: insults cost 2, apologies/gifts give 1; warm when score is at least 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Robin holds a permanent grudge if the first action is an insult, and otherwise turns cold on any adjacent pair of insults.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Robin tracks unmet insults and accumulated goodwill; an apology cancels one unmet insult, gifts cannot, and warm needs no unmet insults plus some goodwill.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Robin is cold if the first action is an insult, and otherwise is warm only when insults are outnumbered by non-insults.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Robin has a hidden goodwill score: insult -4, apologise +2, gift +1; warm iff score >= 0.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Robin has a hidden score (insult -4, apologise +2, gift +1), and consecutive gifts add +1 per adjacent pair; warm iff score >= 0.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Robin has a hidden score (insult -4, apologise +2, gift +1), and consecutive insults subtract an extra -1 per adjacent pair; warm iff score >= 0.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Robin has a hidden score (insult -4, apologise +2, gift +1), and a gift immediately after an insult subtracts an extra -1; warm iff score >= 0.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Trust score: apology +2, gift +1, insult -3; warm iff no adjacent insults and score >= 2.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Patience meter: apology/gift +1, insult -2; below -1 is permanent ruin; warm iff first action apology, not ruined, and patience >= 0.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: First apology opens trust; warm only if no adjacent insults and the last action is not an insult.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Warm iff the first action was apology and Robin has been insulted at most once overall.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 1
survivors.comment: Trust score: apology +2, gift +1, insult -3; warm iff no adjacent insults and score >= 2.

shown the survivors.comment: Robin is warm iff there have been no consecutive insults and the trust score (apology +2, gift +1, insult -3) is at least 2.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin's hidden anger starts at 0 (warm); insult sets it to 1 if currently 0, otherwise adds 3; apology subtracts 1 (not below 0); gift does nothing; warm iff anger is 0.
